scenes.tts: You need five clear containers with tight lids, packing tape, and damp soil. Add an apple slice, a dry leaf, bread, and a bottle cap.
scenes.narration: You need five clear containers with tight lids, packing tape, and damp soil. Add an apple slice, a dry leaf, bread, and a bottle cap.

scenes.tts: An adult does the setup. Put damp soil and one item in the first four. The fifth gets apple and no soil. Then close and tape each lid all the way around.

items.text: Soil and one item in four

scenes.narration: An adult does the setup. Put damp soil and one item in the first four. The fifth gets apple and no soil. Then close and tape each lid all the way around.

scenes.tts: Look twice a week for three to four weeks. Bread often grows fuzzy mold within one to two weeks. Both apples usually rot.
scenes.narration: Look twice a week for three to four weeks. Bread often grows fuzzy mold within one to two weeks. Both apples usually rot.

scenes.tts: An adult seals every container, and nobody opens one. Mold spores can set off allergies and asthma, so anyone with asthma, a mold allergy, or a weakened immune system should not handle them.
scenes.narration: An adult seals every container, and nobody opens one. Mold spores can set off allergies and asthma, so anyone with asthma, a mold allergy, or a weakened immune system should not handle them.
